memory_candidates.content: A task closed [BLOCKED] under a user-prescribed kill-criterion carries requires_user_review: true and an empty dependencies array. Repository-review heuristics that flag '[BLOCKED] with zero unmet dependencies' as stale misclassify these by construction — a user-decision gate looks identical to a stale dependency block in the task graph. Check requires_user_review before reopening.

When re-pricing a formalisation cost estimate against work that has since landed, check the DIRECTION of the landed theorem, not just its size. CSLib's Nested/ development landed ADS15 Theorem 4.1 (nested proof implies Hilbert derivability) sorry-free, but an underivability/exclusion argument consumes the converse (Hilbert implies cut-free nested) plus cut-elimination — so 2,953 landed lines moved the cost estimate not at all.
